description: Scrabble Score Calculator — real English tile values with double/triple letter and word bonuses plus the 50-point bingo.

faqs.a: A1 B3 C3 D2 E1 F4 G2 H4 I1 J8 K5 L1 M3 N1 O1 P3 Q10 R1 S1 T1 U1 V4 W4 X8 Y4 Z2 — standard English Scrabble tile values.
faqs.q: Which tile values do you use?

faqs.a: Letter bonuses (DL/TL) apply to individual tiles first, then the whole word total is multiplied by any word bonuses (DW/TW). Two DWs quadruple the word.
faqs.q: In what order do bonuses apply?

faqs.a: Using all 7 tiles in one play adds a 50-point bingo bonus — tick the checkbox when your play uses your whole rack.

howto: Set DL/TL on any premium letter squares.
Set DW/TW if the word covers premium word squares.
Tick bingo if you used all 7 tiles, then Calculate.
title: Scrabble Score Calculator
